# Cost tracks the index rather than the model

Evidence sits beside the claim rather than under it.

---

# A slide that carries its own script loses the room

Retrieval reads from an index that grows with the corpus, so its cost follows the index rather than
the model, and a larger model costs no more to serve. Fine-tuning pays for every parameter on every
call, which is why its cost climbs with the model, whatever the corpus holds.
